SeisTool

Rock Physics Software

SeisTool is TraceSeis's rock physics software platform, designed to support geoscientists in analyzing relationships between rock properties and seismic data. The tool helps reduce subsurface uncertainty by providing quantitative analysis capabilities.

View on traceseis.com

SeisInv

Seismic Inversion Software · In Development

SeisInv is a seismic inversion to reservoir properties software currently under development. It will extend TraceSeis's proprietary methodology for reservoir property estimation into a dedicated software platform.
